qolFindings.title: Unconfirmed: on Playwright WebKit, the app sometimes stays on 'Apertura del corso…' after the launch switch reloads it
qolFindings.evidence: iphone project: createCourse, store a session, page.reload(), wait for the second load, open Impostazioni. In 2 of 4 runs of a two-tab scratch spec the page showed only 'Apertura del corso…' and Impostazioni never appeared within 20 s; the other 2 runs and every Pixel run passed. Vite dev server on Windows with another agent committing at the same time: possibly an environment flake, not tied to a field-UX change. Worth one run of the repo's iphone-13-webkit-core project around the switch reload before the owner's iPhone check.
qolFindings.reproduction: Scratch spec r4b 'two tabs' on project iphone, --repeat-each=4.

roundThreeRecheck.FUX-B3-R3-1: RESOLVED. One tap during a 3 s launch check: 'Backup pronto. Riapri l'app per attivarlo.', no reload (loads 1). 'Riapri l'app' plus a hurried tap 1 s later: one reload, then 'Accesso: istruttore@example.test | In attesa di connessione: 1 modifica da inviare.' (loads 2).
roundThreeRecheck.FUX-B3-R3-Q1: RESOLVED. Token refresh slowed to 6 s: 'Verifica dell'accesso…' at 0.5 s and 2 s, 'Accesso: …' at 8 s. Offline next morning: 'Verifica dell'accesso…' for about 3-4 s, then 'Accesso: … In attesa di connessione: 1 modifica da inviare.'
roundThreeRecheck.regressions: None in the field path. New student with a Sesso tap during the launch check: no reload, form kept (Pixel and iPhone). Open evaluation note, tap outside: no alert, no reload (both). Code plus Enter: one reload, signed in (both). Esci in tab A signs tab B out (Pixel). Offline Esci 3.6 s (Pixel), 4.0 s (iPhone).
roundThreeRecheck.switchedHere reload: A tab that ran the switch reloads even if touched during it; the window is about a second for a small course and the tab can no longer save anyway. No data loss observed.

fieldWalkthrough: Slow pier morning: tap at once, the switch waits, Impostazioni says 'Backup pronto', one tap on 'Riapri l'app', one reload, 'Accesso … 1 modifica da inviare'. Nothing typed is lost. Offline 'Verifica dell'accesso…' for about 3 s, then the honest waiting line. Nothing read twice.
